name: OmniSource API v2
description: Production-grade metadata intelligence API for OmniStore clients.

endpoints.description: Full discovery catalog with trust scores, health, and relationships.
One normalized app record (schemas/app.schema.json) plus versions and health. One document per catalog id.
Source index with health and reputation.
Trending, rising, and recently updated apps.
Featured apps (slim records) for storefront shelves.
Categories with counts and member slugs.
Sequenced release timeline for incremental (delta) sync. Persist sequenceHigh and apply newer sequences only.
Feed manifest: schemaVersion, feedVersion, minimumClientVersion and per-document SHA-256 checksums.
Related apps, alternatives, and per-app recommendations.
Source health status, uptime, latency, and pipeline state.
App relationship graph: apps, developers, sources, edges.
Per-app trust, security, and maintenance scores.

notes: v2 endpoints are generated on every sync by the OmniSource pipeline. Clients should use these URLs for OmniStore and third-party integrations.
